# doxastic content

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:doxasticContent`](gmeow-doxasticContent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/doxasticContent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/epistemics`](../../slices/epistemics.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The [`Proposition`](../classes/gmeow-Proposition.md) that is the content of a [`DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) — what the agent believes. Functional and constitutive: one doxastic state is directed at exactly one proposition.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) -> [`gmeow:Proposition`](../classes/gmeow-Proposition.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:doxasticContent`](gmeow-doxasticContent.md) from [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) to [`gmeow:Proposition`](../classes/gmeow-Proposition.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Belief Revision

- **Source:** [`slices/core/epistemics/examples/belief-revision.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/epistemics/examples/belief-revision.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-belief-revision)#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-belief-revision

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/epistemics/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- Original belief (high credence, unequivocal) -----------------------------
ex:originalBelief a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "original belief: the printer is broken"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propPrinterBroken ;
    gmeow:credence "0.92"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:originalClaim .

# --- Revised belief (lower credence, probable) --------------------------------
ex:revisedBelief a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "revised belief: printer may be broken"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propPrinterBroken ;
    gmeow:credence "0.35"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:revisedClaim .
```

### Flagship Epistemic Ledger

- **Source:** [`slices/core/epistemics/examples/flagship-epistemic-ledger.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/epistemics/examples/flagship-epistemic-ledger.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-flagship-epistemic-ledger)#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-flagship-epistemic-ledger

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/epistemics/flagship/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- Original credence-weighted belief (operator) --------------------------------
ex:opBeliefOriginal a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "original belief: LLM recalled the meeting date correctly"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propRecall ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:opClaimOriginal ;
    gmeow:credence "0.85"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:justifiedBy ex:evidenceSpan1 .

# --- Revised belief after a defeater ---------------------------------------------
ex:opBeliefRevised a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "revised belief: LLM probably misremembered the meeting date"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propRecall ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:opClaimRevised ;
    gmeow:credence "0.30"^^xsd:decimal .
```

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md), [`gmeow:Proposition`](../classes/gmeow-Proposition.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a [`DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) to the truth-apt proposition it is about.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the flat spine: [`gmeow:believes`](gmeow-believes.md) already points from agent to proposition directly.

### How to use

- Set exactly once per [`DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md), pairing it with [`epistemicAgent`](gmeow-epistemicAgent.md) and [`doxasticClaim`](gmeow-doxasticClaim.md).

### Examples

- ex:aliceBelievesRound [`gmeow:doxasticContent`](gmeow-doxasticContent.md) ex:earthIsRound.
